item.title: Democrats embrace a more alluring image for midterms
item.description: The party appears to be adopting a more provocative social media presence, with unbuttoned shirts and visible biceps becoming part of the strategy.

item.title: Rising borrowing costs burden heavily indebted nations
item.description: Governments worldwide face higher borrowing costs, with more revenue going toward interest payments as debt levels remain high.

item.title: Young adults increasingly wary of AI's benefits
item.description: A majority of U.S. adults under 30 are now more concerned than excited about AI's growing role in daily life, according to Pew data.

item.title: UN inspectors visit Syrian nuclear sites for first time
item.description: UN inspectors visited several undeclared Assad-era Syrian nuclear sites for the first time, including locations used to store nuclear material.
